name: 小糸
trans: G-Good morning......

name: 小糸
text:
えっと……
ノート、ノート……
trans:
Umm... My notebook...
Notebook......

name: 小糸
text: はづきさんの机のとこ……
trans: Should be on top of Hazuki-san's desk......

name: 小糸
trans: T-There it is......!

name: 恋鐘
text:
ちょっと味見係するだけやけん！
座って座って～！
trans:
You just hafta be my taste taster for a bit!
Go on, take a sit～！

name: 恋鐘
trans: I'm hella confident 'bout da taste!

name: 美琴
trans:
Okay...
I mean......

name: 美琴
text: 見た目も、売り物みたいだし……
trans:
These do look like...
...something you'd see in a restaurant......

name: 恋鐘
trans: Spot on～!

name: 恋鐘
text:
あ！　もしかして
なんか苦手なもん入っとる～？
trans:
Ah! Don't tell me, is there anythin'
there that ya don't eat～?!

name: 恋鐘
text: ばってん、好き嫌いはよくなかよ
trans:
Tho', it ain't gonna be good
for ya to be a picky eater!

name: 美琴
text: そういうわけじゃないんだけど……
trans: That's not exactly the case here, though......

name: 小糸
trans:
......S-Sounds like there's
other people over there...?

name: 美琴
text:
あの、これ
味見って量じゃ無いと思うんだけど……
trans:
Um, I just think that, this is not the
normal portion for a taste test...

name: 恋鐘
text:
よかよか！
足らんかったらまた作るばい！
trans:
M'kay, heard ya! Imma just cook more 
when ya need a refill so all's fine!

name: 美琴
trans: ......That's not what I mean...

name: 恋鐘
text:
これから練習やろ～？
たっくさん食べて、元気つけて行かんばね！
trans:
Ya gonna go to practice soon, ain'tcha? 
Ya hafta eat a ton, load up on energy, then go nuts!

name: 恋鐘
trans: Here ya go, enjoy yer meal～!

name: 恋鐘
text:
あれ、小糸！
いつからおったと？
trans:
Hey, ain't it Koito!
How long have ya been standing there for?

name: 小糸
text:
わ、忘れ物、取りに……
す、すみません……
trans:
I-I just came to... get my stuff...
i-i'm sorry......

name: 恋鐘
text:
ふぇ……
なんで謝ると？
trans: Fweh, what are ya apologizin' fer?

name: 恋鐘
text:
ちょうどよか！
小糸も味見していって！
trans:
Ya came at the perfect timin'!
Sit and have a taste here too, Koito!

name: 美琴
text:
……よかったら
手伝ってくれないかな
trans:
...If it's alright with you,
can you help me out here?

name: 美琴
text:
一人じゃ、食べ切れないから
……絶対
trans:
I can't really eat all of these alone... 
...It's just impossible.

name: 美琴
trans: ...Pretty please?

name: 恋鐘
text:
んふふ～！
そしたら小糸の分ばよそってくるばい！
trans:
Mwehehe!
Imma fetch your portion then, Koito!

name: 美琴
text:
待って
これ、分けて頂くから
trans:
Stop there.
We'll just share this one.

name: 美琴
text:
お皿だけ貰えたら大丈夫
……ね？
trans:
She just needs her own plate.
...Right?

name: 小糸
text:
い、今そんなに
たくさんは……
trans: I-I can't eat that much... right now, so......

name: 恋鐘
trans: Ya sure～?

name: 美琴
trans: Yep.

name: 美琴
text:
それにこの後、ユニットのメンバーと
一緒に食べるって言っていたでしょ？
trans:
Besides, you mentioned that you'll be eating
these with your unit members, right?

name: 美琴
trans: You need to leave enough for five people.

name: 恋鐘
text:
ん～……そいもそうやね！
じゃあお皿出すけん、待っとって
trans:
Hmm～ Guess yer right there!
Gonna fetch ya a plate, then! Wait a bit!

name: 美琴
trans: ......Thank you.

name: 美琴
trans: Sorry to pull you into this.

name: 小糸
trans:
Ah...
N-No problem......

name: 美琴
text:
この後、ユニットで……
アンティーカで集まるみたい
trans:
She'll be meeting up with her unit after this,
apparently... With L'Antica.

name: 小糸
trans: I-Is... that so...

name: 美琴
text:
こんなふうに
アイドルが事務所で料理しているなんて
trans:
To have your idols cooking in an
office kitchen on a random day like this...

name: 美琴
trans: ...Truly, what a bizarre agency.
